items.exampleEn: The old mining town is now a place of desolation and silence.
items.exampleZh: 那座老礦鎮如今一片荒涼、寂靜。

items.exampleEn: Scientists study the sun's corona with special cameras.
items.exampleZh: 科學家用特殊的相機研究太陽的日冕。

items.exampleEn: The rainstorm finally brought water to the dry farms.
items.exampleZh: 那場暴風雨終於為乾旱的農田帶來了水。

items.exampleEn: The blooming cherry trees attract many visitors every spring.
items.exampleZh: 盛開的櫻花樹每年春天都吸引許多遊客。

items.exampleEn: We heard a lark singing high above the field.
items.exampleZh: 我們聽到一隻雲雀在田野高空中歌唱。

items.exampleEn: Divers explored an undersea cave full of colorful fish.
items.exampleZh: 潛水員探索了一個滿是彩色魚群的海底洞穴。

items.exampleEn: Our beagle loves to follow interesting smells in the park.
items.exampleZh: 我們家的米格魯很愛在公園裡循著有趣的氣味走。

items.sentenceEn: The rainstorm last night knocked down several trees on our street.
items.sentenceZh: 昨晚的暴風雨吹倒了我們這條街上好幾棵樹。

items.audioEn: Our beagle, Coco, barks at every bird she sees, but she is afraid of cats.
items.audioZh: 我們家的米格魯 Coco 看到鳥就叫，但牠怕貓。
items.questionZh: Coco 看到鳥時會怎麼做？

items.sentenceEn: Larks build their homes on the ground, not in trees.
items.sentenceZh: 雲雀把巢築在地上，而不是樹上。

items.sentenceEn: This undersea tunnel connects the two islands.
items.sentenceZh: 這條海底隧道連接兩座島。

items.stemEn: The garden is full of ____ roses, so the air smells wonderful.
items.stemZh: 花園裡滿是盛開的玫瑰，所以空氣聞起來很香。

items.stemEn: We waited inside the cafe until the ____ had passed.
items.stemZh: 我們在咖啡館裡等到暴風雨過去。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, I took my beagle, Coco, to a small island off the coast. On Saturday morning, a heavy rainstorm hit the island, so we stayed in our room. In the afternoon, the sky cleared, and we walked along the cliffs. Wild flowers were blooming everywhere, and a lark flew up from the grass in front of us. On Sunday, we visited an undersea viewing room, where we watched fish swimming around the coral. That evening, a thin mist covered the sea, and we saw a corona around the moon.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我帶著我的米格魯 Coco 去海岸外的一座小島。星期六早上，一場大暴風雨襲擊小島，所以我們待在房間裡。下午天空放晴，我們沿著懸崖散步。野花到處盛開，一隻雲雀從我們前方的草叢裡飛起。星期日，我們參觀了一間海底觀景室，在那裡看魚群在珊瑚之間穿梭。那天晚上，一層薄霧籠罩海面，我們看到月亮周圍有一圈光環。

questions.questionZh: 星期六早上他們為什麼待在房間裡？
options: 外面正下著很大的暴風雨

items.promptZh: 沙漠裡一片荒涼，看不到任何人或動物。
referenceEn: The desert was a scene of desolation, with no people or animals in sight.
There was only desolation in the desert; we saw no people or animals.
rubricZh: 要用 desolation 當名詞（例如 a scene of desolation、only desolation）
「看不到任何人或動物」可寫，例如 no people or animals in sight、we saw no people or animals 等
時態合理即可（例如 was、is）

items.instructionZh: 用 beagle 造一個句子，說說你認識或看過的一隻米格魯。
referenceEn: My neighbor has a beagle that barks at the postman every day.
I once saw a tiny beagle sleeping in a shopping bag.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 beagle（例如 a beagle、my beagle）
時態配合內容（例如 has、saw 等）
